units.source_text: 岛村即使没有唤驹子，驹子不用说也是常常来找他的。

en.t: Even when Shimamura did not send for Komako, she naturally came to see him often.

units.source_text: 他去溪流尽头观赏红叶，曾打驹子家门前走过，那时候，她听见车声，断定又是岛村，便跑到外面来看。

en.t: When he went to view the autumn leaves at the head of the stream, he once passed in front of Komako's house; hearing the sound of the car then, she decided it must be Shimamura again and ran outside to look.
But Shimamura did not even turn his head.
So she called him a heartless man.

units.source_text: 她只要被唤到客栈，没有不去岛村的房间的。

en.t: Whenever she was called to the inn, she never failed to go to Shimamura's room.

units.source_text: 去浴室的时候，也顺便走来了。

en.t: Even when she went to the bath, she would stop by on the way.

units.source_text: 若有宴会，就提前一个钟头来，一直在他那里玩到女佣来叫她。

en.t: If there was a banquet, she came an hour early and stayed there with him, amusing herself until a maid came to call her.

units.source_text: 她还常常从宴会上偷偷溜出来，对着梳妆镜修整面容。

en.t: She would also often slip out from a banquet and tidy her face in front of the dressing mirror.
